owner: organizer WhatsApp inbox and reply callables
read: current organizer managers get and list one thread's messages (organizerId and threadId equality)
migrationNotes: Inbound and outbound bodies expire after 12 months; per-thread and per-contact deletion are intentionally out of scope.

Bodies are personal data. Since #1339 the organizer's current managers read them under rules for the inbox listener; the fields are the ones the callable returned plus contact, sender connection, provider message and replying manager ids, none of them credentials.
rulesTestNames: lets current managers read WhatsApp thread views and one thread's messages
